text.tspan: No One Likes to Be Left Out
Principles on How to Be a Proper Human Being — General
Greet a new friend with a grin!
Be tenderhearted, kind to one another.
“Join with us and come right in!”
Be tenderhearted, kind to one another.
We have space for every one;
Be tenderhearted, kind to one another.
